title: Single-cell RNA Sequencing Identifies Natural Kill Cell-Related Transcription Factors Associated With Age-Related Macular Degeneration.
authors: Luo, Yili; Liu, Jianpeng; Feng, Wangqiang; Lin, Da; Chen, Mengji; Zheng, Haihua
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单细胞RNA-seq和SCENIC识别AMD中NK细胞相关转录因子，但仅基于转录组统计与机器学习筛选，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) poses a growing global health concern as the leading cause of central vision loss in elderly people. OBJECTION: This study focuses on unraveling the intricate involvement of Natural Killer (NK) cells in AMD, shedding light on their immune responses and cytokine regulatory roles. METHODS: Transcriptomic data from the Gene Expression Omnibus database were utilized, employing single-cell RNA-seq analysis. High-dimensional weighted gene co-expression network analysis (hdWGCNA) and single-cell regulatory network inference and clustering (SCENIC) analysis were applied to reveal the regulatory mechanisms of NK cells in early-stage AMD patients. Machine learning models, such as random forests and decision trees, were employed to screen hub genes and key transcription factors (TFs) associated with AMD. RESULTS: Distinct cell clusters were identified in the present study, especially the T/NK cluster, with a notable increase in NK cell abundance observed in AMD. Cell-cell communication analyses revealed altered interactions, particularly in NK cells, indicating their potential role in AMD pathogenesis. HdWGCNA highlighted the turquoise module, enriched in inflammation-related pathways, as significantly associated with AMD in NK cells. The SCENIC analysis identified key TFs in NK cell regulatory networks. The integration of hub genes and TFs identified CREM, FOXP1, IRF1, NFKB2, and USF2 as potential predictors for AMD through machine learning. CONCLUSION: This comprehensive approach enhances our understanding of NK cell dynamics, signaling alterations, and potential predictive models for AMD. The identified TFs provide new avenues for molecular interventions and highlight the intricate relationship between NK cells and AMD pathogenesis. Overall, this study contributes valuable insights for advancing our understanding and management of AMD.
abstract_zh: 背景：年龄相关性黄斑变性（Age-Related Macular Degeneration, AMD）作为老年人中心视力丧失的主要原因，日益成为全球健康关注焦点。目的：本研究旨在揭示自然杀伤（Natural Killer, NK）细胞在AMD中的复杂参与机制，阐明其免疫反应及细胞因子调控作用。方法：利用基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus）数据库的转录组数据，采用单细胞RNA测序分析。应用高维加权基因共表达网络分析（hdWGCNA）和单细胞调控网络推断与聚类（SCENIC）分析，揭示早期AMD患者中NK细胞的调控机制。采用随机森林和决策树等机器学习模型，筛选与AMD相关的核心基因和关键转录因子（TFs）。结果：本研究识别出不同的细胞簇，尤其是T/NK簇，并观察到AMD中NK细胞丰度显著增加。细胞间通讯分析显示，特别是NK细胞中的相互作用发生改变，提示其在AMD发病机制中的潜在作用。HdWGCNA突出显示蓝绿色模块，富含炎症相关通路，与NK细胞中的AMD显著相关。SCENIC分析识别了NK细胞调控网络中的关键转录因子。通过整合核心基因和转录因子，机器学习识别出CREM、FOXP1、IRF1、NFKB2和USF2作为AMD的潜在预测因子。结论：这种综合方法增进了我们对NK细胞动态、信号改变及AMD潜在预测模型的理解。所识别的转录因子为分子干预提供了新途径，并强调了NK细胞与AMD发病机制之间的复杂关系。总体而言，本研究为推进AMD的理解和管理提供了宝贵见解。
